Meta.titre: Riad Dar Selma | Guesthouse in the Marrakech medina
Meta.description: Six rooms around an orange-tree courtyard in the Marrakech medina.
Meta.contact: Request a booking at Riad Dar Selma: we reply within 24 hours, with no commitment and no prepayment.
Meta.donneesStructurees: A family house from 1860 in the Marrakech medina: six rooms around an orange-tree courtyard, a hammam and a terrace facing the Atlas.

hero.accroche: Six rooms around an orange-tree courtyard in the Marrakech medina.
hero.photo: The riad's courtyard, with its pool and trees

esprit.label: The house
esprit.texte: A family house from 1860, restored room by room. A pool, orange trees, a terrace facing the Atlas.

table.texte: Seasonal dinner in the courtyard. Book by the morning.
table.photo: Moroccan dishes served on a table

hammam.texte: Private, with black soap scrub and rhassoul clay.

terrasse.texte: Breakfast or drinks facing the Atlas.
terrasse.photo: View over the medina and the Atlas peaks

excursions.texte: Ourika, Agafay, Essaouira. We book the driver and guide.
excursions.photo: Earthen village in an Atlas valley

galerie.patio: The courtyard and its pool, seen from above

liste.citation: “You open the door and the noise of the medina is gone.”
“Excellent dinners, and a team that is attentive and discreet.”
“We had every breakfast on the Suite Atlas terrace.”

acces.label: Getting here
acces.adresse: 12 Derb Lalla Selma, Mouassine, Marrakech medina (fictional address)

aeroport.texte: 25 min by car. Transfer on request.

parking.texte: 6 min on foot. Cars cannot enter the medina.

arrivee.texte: We meet you at the car park and carry your bags.

acces.carte: Map of the Marrakech medina showing the riad

appel.texte: We reply within 24 hours. No prepayment.

Chambre.equipementsTexte: Breakfast in the courtyard or on the terrace, whenever suits you.

accroches.safran: Opens onto the courtyard, with golden late-afternoon light.
accroches.jasmin: Small and cool, steps from the pool and the climbing jasmine.
accroches.cedre: Under a hand-painted cedar ceiling, above the orange trees.
accroches.neroli: The brightest room on the gallery, with an alcove for a third guest.
accroches.indigo: Midnight-blue tadelakt walls, raw linen, a carved wooden screen window.
accroches.suite-atlas: On the top floor, with a private terrace facing the Atlas peaks.
